academic_translation:
This leisure and endowment is extremely difficult to find;
Since that which accomplishes human purpose has been attained,
If one does not accomplish what is beneficial with this,
How will this be perfectly found again later?
translation: This free and fortunate life is very hard to find. We have gained what we need to reach the purpose of a human life. If we do not use this life to do what is helpful, how will we ever find a life like this again?

academic_translation:
Those who wish to overcome the hundreds of sufferings of existence,
Who wish to dispel the unhappiness of sentient beings,
And who wish to enjoy many hundreds of joys,
Should never forsake bodhicitta.
translation: People who want to end the hundreds of sufferings of life, to take away the sadness of living beings, and to enjoy hundreds of joys should never give up the awakening mind.

academic_translation:
When bodhicitta is generated, in an instant,
The wretched bound in the prison of saṃsāra
Will be called the children of the Sugatas,
And will be paid homage by the world, including its gods and humans.
translation: As soon as the awakening mind is born, in a single moment, poor beings trapped in the prison of the cycle of rebirth will be called children of the Well-Gone Ones. The whole world, including gods and humans, will bow down to them.

academic_translation:
Since the sole caravan leader of wandering beings, with limitless intellect,
Has thoroughly examined it and found it to be highly precious,
Those who wish to be separated from the realms of wandering beings
Should firmly hold to precious bodhicitta.
translation: The one leader of travelers for all beings has a limitless mind. He looked at it closely and saw how precious it is. Because of this, anyone who wants to be free from the realms of beings should hold tightly to the precious awakening mind.

academic_translation:
Like the fire at the end of time, it
Certainly burns up great misdeeds in a single instant.
Its immeasurable benefits
Were explained to Sudhana by the wise Protector Maitreya.
translation: It is like the fire at the end of time. It completely burns up great harmful deeds in a single instant. The wise Protector Maitreya explained its endless benefits to Sudhana.

academic_translation:
From the moment that, to thoroughly liberate
The infinite realm of sentient beings,
With an irreversible mind,
One correctly adopts that mind,
translation: From the moment you truly take up this mind to completely free the endless realm of living beings, with a mind of never turning back,

academic_translation:
Together with the reasoning for this,
In the Question of Subāhu,
For the sake of sentient beings with lesser inclinations,
The Tathāgata himself proclaimed this.
translation: The Thus-Gone One himself explained this. He gave the reasons for it in the teaching called the Question of Subahu. He said this to help living beings whose wishes are still small.

academic_translation:
That intention for the welfare of sentient beings,
Which does not arise in others even for their own sake—
This extraordinary jewel of a mind
Is born as an unprecedented wonder.
translation: Other beings do not have this wish even for themselves. But this wish to help every living being is born as a brand new wonder. It is an amazing jewel of a mind.

academic_translation:
For those who are destitute of happiness
And who have many sufferings,
That which satisfies them with all happiness
And cuts through all suffering,
translation: For beings who have no happiness and face so much suffering, this mind fills them with happiness and cuts through all their suffering.

academic_translation:
If anyone toward such a benefactor, a child of the Victors,
Generates a malicious thought, that one,
For eons equal to the number of malicious thoughts generated,
Will abide in hell, so the Sage has taught.
translation: What if someone has a hateful thought toward such a kind child of the Victorious Ones? The Sage taught that they will stay in hell for one great age for every hateful thought.

academic_translation:
In whomever that supreme, precious mind
Has arisen, I bow to their body;
And those to whom even doing harm connects one to happiness—
I go for refuge to those sources of happiness.
translation: I bow down to the body of anyone in whom this supreme, precious mind has arisen. Even if someone hurts them, they still connect that person to happiness. I go for shelter to these sources of happiness.

academic_translation:
Even in the worlds of gods and others, fragrances,
Incense, wish-fulfilling trees, and jewel trees,
Various crops that grow without being ploughed,
And other ornaments worthy of being offered,
translation: I offer sweet smells and incense from the worlds of gods and others. I offer wish-granting trees and jewel trees. I offer crops that grow without anyone ploughing the field. I offer every other beautiful thing that is worthy of being offered.

academic_translation:
Taking them up with my mind, to the Sages, the supreme among persons,
Together with their children, I excellently offer them;
May those supreme worthy recipients of offerings, those of great compassion,
Think of me with love and accept these things of mine.
translation: In my mind, I gather all these things. I offer them to the Sages, the best of beings, and to their children. They are the greatest ones worthy of gifts. May those of great compassion think of me with love and accept my offerings.

academic_translation:
I am without merit and extremely destitute,
And I have no other wealth at all for making offerings.
Therefore, may the Protectors who consider the welfare of others
Accept this for my sake by their own power.
translation: I have no store of goodness, and I am very poor. I have no other wealth to offer. Therefore, may the Protectors who care about the good of others accept this for my sake by their own power.

academic_translation:
Overwhelmed by the confusion of ignorance,
Whatever I have rejoiced in,
Having seen those mistakes,
I confess them to the Protectors from the depths of my heart.
translation: Ignorance confused me completely. I used to feel joy in my mistakes. Now I see these mistakes. I own up to them to the Protectors from the bottom of my heart.

academic_translation:
Without the purification of my misdeeds,
I will die before that happens.
So that there is definite liberation from these misdeeds,
Please protect me swiftly.
translation: I will die before the cleansing of my harmful deeds. Please protect me quickly so I can have sure freedom from them.

academic_translation:
In the Dharma they have realized,
Which dispels the fears of saṃsāra,
And in the assembly of bodhisattvas,
Likewise, I perfectly take refuge.
translation: In the same way, the teachings they have realized are what I go to for shelter. These teachings chase away the fears of the cycle of rebirth. The group of awakening heroes is also who I go to for shelter.

academic_translation:
Whose conduct through compassion is unerring,
To the protector Avalokiteśvara as well,
I cry out with an anguished voice:
"Please protect me, one possessing misdeeds!"

locked_terms.use: one who has done harmful deeds

translation: Because of his compassion, his actions never go wrong. I cry out in a sad voice to the protector Avalokiteshvara. I say, "Please protect me, one who has done harmful deeds!"

academic_translation:
Previously, I transgressed your commands;
Now, having seen great fear,
I take refuge in you.
Please swiftly dispel my fears!
translation: In the past, I went against your commands. Now I have seen great fear. You are the one I go to for shelter. Please take away my fears quickly!

academic_translation:
If even just one of them, in Jambudvīpa,
Destroys all the people dwelling there,
And no other medicine to cure them
Can be found anywhere in all directions—
translation: Imagine if just one of these illnesses could destroy all the people living in Jambudvipa. And imagine if no medicine to cure them could be found anywhere.

academic_translation:
In that case, of the Omniscient Physician
Who draws out all pain,
The intention not to act according to his commands
Is extreme ignorance and an object of reproach.
translation: In that case, for the All-Knowing Doctor who takes away all pain, not wanting to follow his commands is extreme ignorance. Anyone who ignores him should be scolded.

academic_translation:
Even at a small, ordinary precipice,
If one must remain careful,
Of falling a thousand yojanas
Into a long-lasting precipice, what need to mention?
translation: We must be careful even near a small, normal cliff. So of course we must be careful when we could fall a thousand leagues into a drop that lasts a very long time!

academic_translation:
To the Victors who wish to pass into nirvāṇa,
I join my palms and pray:
Do not leave these wandering beings in blindness,
But please remain for countless eons.
translation: I put my hands together and pray to the Victorious Ones who wish to pass into freedom from sorrow. Do not leave these beings in blindness. Please stay with us for countless great ages.

academic_translation:
Just as the Sugatas of former times
Generated bodhicitta
And in the trainings of the bodhisattvas
Progressively abided,
translation: Just as the Well-Gone Ones of the past created the awakening mind and, step by step, followed the trainings of the awakening heroes,

academic_translation:
Likewise, for the benefit of wandering beings,
I shall generate bodhicitta,
And likewise in the trainings too
I shall progressively train.
translation: In the same way, I will create the awakening mind to help all beings. Step by step, I will also practice the trainings.
